case_name: Hey Listen Mandyhan, L.L.C. v. Trody

issues.label: Definition of 'dwelling' under R.C. 5313.01(B)
issues.why: Whether the existing converted garage constitutes property 'improved by virtue of a dwelling having been erected' determines Chapter 5313's applicability.

issues.label: Whether new structure must be erected
issues.why: Trial court read the statute to require erecting a new dwelling, an interpretation that must be tested against the statutory text.

issues.label: Relevance of commercial zoning to dwelling status
issues.why: Whether the CN zoning classification bears on whether the structure is a residential dwelling for land-installment purposes.

issues.label: Actual residential use as evidence of dwelling
issues.why: Trody's renovation into an apartment and continuous residence may qualify the premises as a dwelling regardless of original purpose.

issues.label: Simultaneous execution of lease and purchase agreement
issues.why: Contemporaneous agreements on the same subject may be read together as one transaction affecting characterization as a land installment contract.

issues.label: Effect of integration clause
issues.why: Whether the lease's integration clause bars considering the purchase agreement to determine the parties' true agreement.

issues.label: Land installment contract vs. lease-with-option
issues.why: The core dispute whether the agreements form a R.C. 5313.02 land contract or a lease with a separate purchase option.

issues.label: Statutory requirements of R.C. 5313.02
issues.why: Whether the agreements meet the mandatory content requirements of a valid land installment contract.

issues.label: Substantial compliance with R.C. 5313.02
issues.why: Even if noncompliant, an agreement substantially complying may still be enforceable as a land contract, an issue the court deemed moot.

issues.label: Ten-day notice to cure under R.C. 5313.06
issues.why: If a land contract exists, the three-day notice was insufficient and eviction was procedurally improper.

issues.label: Foreclosure requirement under R.C. 5313.07
issues.why: If 20% of purchase price paid, forfeiture must proceed by foreclosure, not forcible entry and detainer.

issues.label: Calculation of 20% purchase-price threshold
issues.why: Whether Trody's payments (allegedly $21,543) toward a $35,000 price exceed 20%, considering interest allocation.

issues.label: Sufficiency of three-day notice under R.C. 1923
issues.why: Whether the notice met FED requirements even under a straight lease theory.

issues.label: Rejection of tendered cure payments
issues.why: Whether Mandyhan's refusal of Trody's attempted delinquent payments affects the right to evict.

issues.label: Allocation of monthly payments (rent vs. taxes/purchase)
issues.why: The discrepancy between $459.10 stated rent and $570-$574 actually paid bears on payment characterization and totals.

issues.label: Ambiguity of the agreements
issues.why: Whether the agreements are ambiguous, triggering resort to extrinsic evidence of the parties' intent.

issues.label: Parol evidence and parties' intent
issues.why: Whether extrinsic evidence of intent may be considered given the integration clause and the ambiguity finding.

issues.label: Credibility determinations on appeal/objection
issues.why: Deference owed to the magistrate's credibility finding favoring Mandyhan's witness who denied a land contract.

issues.label: Standard of review of magistrate's decision
issues.why: The trial court must apply the proper standard when reviewing objections under Civ.R. 53.

issues.label: Failure to rule on judicial notice requests
issues.why: The court never explicitly ruled on Trody's requests to notice ledger calculations, potentially affecting the record.

issues.label: Burden and standard of proof in FED action
issues.why: Whether Mandyhan proved entitlement to possession by a preponderance and who bore burden on the land-contract defense.

issues.label: Effect of prior representations at formation
issues.why: Trody's testimony of a November 2021 purchase understanding and Grabow's conduct may show intent to sell.

issues.label: Landlord approval of residential conversion
issues.why: Mandyhan providing materials and approving apartment creation may estop denial of residential/dwelling character.
